combos.prerequisites: You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1. You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
combos.steps:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to one.
The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Nest of Scarabs and Blowfly Infestation trigger.
Resolve the Nest of Scarabs trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blowfly Infestation trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Repeat from step 2.
